newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aberfoyle says zinc mine posts record.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aberfoyle says zinc mine posts record.

text.p: Aberfoyle Ltd said on Tuesday metallurgical recoveries of lead and zinc reached record levels at its Hellyer mine in Tasmania in the second quarter of 1996/97 (July-June).
The increased recoveries reflected efforts to improve metallurgical performance and favourable ore types treated from the mine, Aberfoyle said in its latest production report.

Aberfoyle also updated the indicated resource base of its Gunpowder copper mine to 6.8 million tonnes, grading 6.3 percent copper, one percent cut off, from 4.7 million tonnes, at 6.7 percent copper, one percent cut off, previously.
A preliminary estimate of the pre-production capital cost of taking production capacity of the Gunpowder mine to 45,000 tonnes of copper a year is A$125 million, Aberfoyle said.
Production of zinc concentrates from the Hellyer mine fell to 63,056 tonnes in the second quarter from 67,762 tonnes in the correponding period a year ago, company figures show.
Output of lead concentrate rose to 19,565 tonnes during the quarter from 16,358 tonnes in the year earlier period.
Aberfoyle also said it has purchased put options giving it the right to convert US$72 million at an exchange rate of US$0.83 to A$1.00 during calendar 1997 at a cost of US$400,000.
Second quarter and six months ended December 31, 1996 (in tonnes unless otherwise stated)
